title: Appeal 23428: one-hour protection of an existing eave within 2 feet of a property line (ORSC R302.1 table)
jurisdiction: City of Portland, Oregon (USA), Bureau of Development Services Administrative Appeal Board; non-Alberta comparative record

facts.text: Appeal item: the R302.1 table does not allow eaves within 2 feet of the property line; the applicant proposes keeping the existing 2 feet 3 inch eave and adding one layer of 5/8-inch Type X to the underside of the rafters.

Decision: alternate one-hour assembly for the north eave is granted provided two layers of 5/8-inch Type X sheathing are on the soffit with blocking, no soffit or wall openings within 3 feet, and no built elements or stormwater crossing the line.
